BWA.note: Document says nothing on rules or an authority on AI harms.
Document names no government AI system.
Document names no sectoral AI tool.
AI mentioned only as a future opportunity; nothing built.
Hub described as to be established and 'once built'; no procurement, build or pilot stated.

facts.fact: Assistant Minister Shawn Ntlhaile said government has completed its draft National Data Policy, which with the National Data Strategy 2027-2032 was being validated at a Gaborone workshop on 25 November 2026 ahead of formal approval.

BWA.note: No body named to carry out the policy; chief data officers are only asked of institutions.
Validation workshop does not name anyone from outside government in the room; partners named are donors and agencies.
